name: AHPS
source:
Autonomous Hologram Projection System. The best and newest from the Gregorian/Terran Engineering Corps. Standard on 2nd Generation Ships. Being retrofitted onto 1st Generation Ships. Available to the extremely wealthy and powerful in the private industry.
